name: Park Hyatt Siem Reap
positioning: Central Siem Reap hotel, formerly Hotel De La Paix, redesigned by Bill Bensley and reopened as Park Hyatt Siem Reap in 2013
best_for: Travelers who want a central city base close to Pub Street, the night bazaars and the Old Market
Guests interested in Khmer cuisine and cultural evenings such as the Apsara Dinner
Couples wanting a suite with a private plunge pool

facts.text: After a multi-year renovation, the hotel reopened as Park Hyatt Siem Reap in 2013, the brand's first in Southeast Asia.
The hotel is set close to Pub Street, the night bazaars and the city center.
The hotel sits between the Royal Gardens and the Old Market in the heart of Siem Reap.
The ground-floor lap pool is shaded by parasols and cabanas.
The Apsara Dinner is held each evening around the Banyan tree in the Courtyard.
At dusk the Courtyard hosts a Candle of Gratitude Ceremony.
The Living Room offers the Khmer Journey of Flavors, featuring regional specialties from 25 provinces.
A Rice Field Sunset experience is available seasonally from November to March.
The Dining Room blends Art Deco elements with Khmer ceramic tableware.
Rooms and suites are finished with Italian marble, handpicked wood and Khmer details.
The Park Executive Suite has its own private plunge pool.
The spa blends traditional Khmer beauty treatments with locally sourced botanicals.

highlights.text: The hotel was formerly known as Hotel De La Paix and was redesigned by architect Bill Bensley.
The Apsara Dinner pairs Khmer cuisine with classical dance under the open sky.
The hotel offers a Temple Dinner at Kravan Temple.
The hotel offers Le Petit Chef, a dining experience that combines theatre and dining.
A free-form pool on the first floor has a lagoon design with green tiles.

considerations.text: Rooms facing the courtyard are quieter, as city view rooms can be noisier.
Siem Reap-Angkor International Airport is 50 kilometers from the hotel.
Some areas within the Rooftop Garden Suite and the Presidential Suite are reached by internal stairs.
